native_ais_steady.definition: AISBench: second attainment of target client concurrency to last attainment; selects requests whose START lies within window, even if END lies outside. Client concurrency includes queued requests.

sampled_server_decode_plateau.definition: Longest contiguous sequence of sampled D running-count sum16, with poll gaps<=10s; discard first and last samples; require>=30s remaining. Occupancy samples are aggregated, non-atomic server snapshots. Throughput counts cumulative SSE usage increments RECEIVED inside this client-monotonic window, not NPU generation timestamps. This is not native AISBench steady.
sampled_server_decode_plateau.reason: No sampled decode16 platform satisfies predeclared duration/gap criteria
